blocks.text: Direction debate — rivals weighed

content.value: Treat the seven deliverables as seven independent slices and fan out. Fast, maximally parallel — but it wastes the compounding structure: the wound-fix proofs WANT the live box the re-fire creates; the re-fire baseline WANTS to run before the bake fix mutates the chain; the honest-evidence fix landing before the turn makes one order prove two things. Parallel-blind sequencing risks proving against divergent states and paying for extra boxes.

Land all fixes, then one live fire proves the repaired chain. Rejected: it destroys the baseline (we would never learn whether c65f517e2 sufficed), and it builds on an unproven chain — the exact sin this wave exists to stop.

children.value: Winner — the box biography (A's parallelism inside B's inverse).

the spine is serial, so a red re-fire could stall the wave behind one failure. Absorbed three ways: the probe (P0) runs first and is independent; the fix lanes never wait on the spine; and the red-re-fire branch is pre-authorized as a re-scope to diagnose-and-fix — the wave's title is Proof Before Build, and a proven failure IS proof. The wish (owner ruling 2026-07-28: pursue now)

Make the system stop lying before anything is built. Seven deliverables: (1) a GREEN provision_support re-fire post-c65f517e2 — none exists on the ledger; (2) PROOF a fleet box executes a real Claude turn — a spend.jsonl row or equivalent hard evidence, including settling muscle-1's real state; (3) the honest-evidence fix — tooling/fleet/fleet-run.sh stamps canned --met and closes unconditionally, violating PDS-D287; (4) the three wound-tasks (task-a0304711e4fe683c bake seed-lineage, task-688ebffc4b0aa50a A-record leak on remove, task-b9c0f988cd0019d4 fleet_token_id nil); (5) first spend telemetry — measured orders/day + token-spend; (6) OPTIONAL+SEVERABLE 1-day GUI spike on a throwaway cx33; (7) ops rider: set BARKPARK_CLOUD_EGRESS_IPS in /etc/barkpark-provisioner.env on the CP host. Direction — the biography of one support box

The wave is organized around a single instrumented support-box lifecycle on the real control plane, bracketed by the cheapest truth first and the fixes proven live. The finished experience: one transcript-backed story — probe, birth, work, death — after which every sentence the fleet says about itself is either proven or honestly absent.

P0 — Probe (seconds, before anything else). A CP-credentialed SSH probe of muscle-1 (capstone ruling O7): does spend.jsonl hold real rows, does the claude binary exist, does fleet-listener.env hold a credential? Rival A — parallel checklist. Treat the seven deliverables as seven independent slices and fan out. Fast, maximally parallel — but it wastes the compounding structure: the wound-fix proofs WANT the live box the re-fire creates; the re-fire baseline WANTS to run before the bake fix mutates the chain; the honest-evidence fix landing before the turn makes one order prove two things. Verifier NOT-FOUNDs that shaped the cut rather than being ignored: no rung probes an EXISTING box in either harness (so P0 has no rung to inherit, only the ssh_box helper); PDFJP_MAIN_ID absent (killing the harness as P1's instrument); the D75 raw hcloud server delete reaper absent from the merged harness (dropped in the D90 fold); no Hetzner DNS client anywhere under cloud/lib/** (killing the CP half of the A-record fix); no spend.jsonl anywhere on this Mac and no task ever assigned to muscle-1 (killing measured orders/day); no CP version endpoint (making deploy currency an inference); and no F1 task on the ledger at all. One verifier REFUSED its own prescribed probe on safety grounds — creating a second ssh-key to test write scope would have broken every provision, because resolveSSHKey auto-selects only when exactly one key exists — and substituted a disjoint probe. That refusal is a finding, now filed as a standing hazard.

Two tooling tripwires worth carrying forward. git grep has no \| alternation: the 'a\|b' form exits 1 on files that DO contain matches, so any "not_found" derived from an alternation grep is a tooling artifact rather than an absence. And the grip ledger's write verb refuses every recipe naming a host, all-or-nothing — so no live-infra fact can enter the ledger through the supported path, which is why this wave's rows are prose.

Decisions — PDF-D97..D106, one line of why each

D97 Credential ground truth. This Mac holds an owner-tier CP session AND a write-scoped fleet hcloud token AND the guerrilla token that owns DNS — MEMORY.md claimed only the last. It does NOT hold barkpark_indx, so every on-box read is owner-gated. Why: this is a blast-radius fact, and capstone O7's "settles it in seconds" presumed a credential this machine lacks.

D98 P1 fires Guerrilla-parented and direct, not via the journey-proof. Why: an instrument that skips the fix under test is a green that proves nothing — and it would cost a second main.

D99 The citation is PDS-D9, not PDF-D9, and it is conditional. Why: a brief citing PDF-D9 points a builder at worktree isolation and reads as noise; and PDS-D9's fail-closed arm names a lawful red-P1 outcome the wave would otherwise have misdiagnosed.

D100 Honest headless evidence is a post-condition READ, never a canned string. Three tiers — path-read with an mtime-after-claim control, receipt-verdict that names its own weakness, honest miss-and-release. Why: a box with no claude binary currently closes its orders green, so every row this runner closed is evidence of nothing.

D101 The A-record fix is CLI-only and sweeps by VALUE; PDF-D63's census goes from four surfaces to five. Why: the CP half needs Elixir DNS plumbing this wave forbids, and a by-name fix would pass its own census while the leak survives — the exact lie class.

D102 fleet_token_id nil is the silent-nil seam, not a stale deploy. Why: every read-only discriminator came back green, and PDF-D68 names the CP row the sole token_id holder — so a nil there is an unrecoverable orphan credential, not cosmetics.

D103 The bake fix is round 2, strictly after P1 fires; the seed count is unmeasured folklore. Why: landing it first degrades the reset step to a no-op and c65f517e2 goes untested again, permanently and invisibly — and the reset step is the only thing that will ever see the seed before destroying it.

D104 The GUI spike is cut on evidence, not deferred on budget. Why: verification answered its motivating question for free; the remaining human-workstation thesis is an owner's product bet, and its externals are now resolved so the day is cheap whenever it is taken.

D105 Spend telemetry ships a measured numerator and a DECLARED denominator, and says so. Why: no spend rows exist anywhere and no task was ever assigned to muscle-1, so orders/day cannot be measured this wave — reporting it as measured would mint exactly the kind of lie the wave exists to kill.

D106 The exposure is wider than muscle-1, and P3 does not close it. Why: the owner's LIVE primary serves its full ledger to an unauthenticated reader; read-tier policy is an owner ruling and prod's own smoke test depends on anonymous reads, so it is filed at top priority rather than fixed under a wave that forbids product construction.

The wave plan — 5 slices (4 build now, 1 deferred)

The shape: most of this wave's deliverables are EXECUTION, not construction. P0, P1, P2 and P3 touch live infrastructure and real money, so builders deliver the FIXES those proofs will test plus the INSTRUMENT that fires them — and the lead/owner executes. That is why there are five slices and not seven.

ROUND 1 — dependency-free, building now. All four are file-disjoint.

1 pdf-w1-p1-refire-instrument · fable · priority 0 · scripts/pdf-p1-refire.sh + scripts/pdf-mvp0-journey-proof.sh · the money-safe live-fire instrument: one Guerrilla-parented provision, watched, censused, torn down — plus closing the merged harness's two teardown holes (token-only cleanup guard; the D75 raw label-delete reaper dropped in the D90 fold). HIGH-FLIP-RISK: the teardown-credential judgment — a red run whose trap cannot reach the box on the operator's actual credential path leaves a billing orphan nobody reaps. Gate: bash -n scripts/pdf-p1-refire.sh && bash scripts/pdf-p1-refire.sh --plan && bash -n scripts/pdf-mvp0-journey-proof.sh && bash scripts/pdf-mvp0-journey-proof.sh --plan.

2 pdf-w1-honest-evidence · fable · priority 1 · tooling/fleet/fleet-run.sh (+ a new fixture test) · the PDS-D287 fix: kill the canned --met and the unconditional close, capture the discarded exit status, bound the turn with a timeout, and carry the verdict into the spend row. HIGH-FLIP-RISK: the verdict predicate — get it wrong in the permissive direction and the fix ships a better-dressed lie. Gate: bash -n tooling/fleet/fleet-run.sh && bash tooling/fleet/fleet-run-verdict-test.sh.

3 pdf-w1-dns-census-leg · fable · priority 1 · internal/cli/cloud_support_cmd.go · delete the leaked A record by VALUE and add the fifth verify-gone census leg, riding the DNS-scoped credential. HIGH-FLIP-RISK: the label-vs-VALUE derivation — the obvious implementation passes its own census while the twin record survives. Gate: CC=clang go build ./... && go vet ./internal/cli/... && go test ./internal/cli/....

4 pdf-w1-tokenid-loud-seam · opus · priority 1 · internal/provisioner/support.go · make the empty-token-id seam loud before P1 reads it, and audit the two remaining silent-loss paths. Well-specified and narrow — the design judgment is already spent in D102. Gate: CC=clang go build ./... && go test ./internal/provisioner/....

ROUND 2 — deferred; the lead dispatches it after the dep merges AND P1 has fired. 5 pdf-w1-bake-seed-reset · fable · priority 2 · AFTER pdf-w1-p1-refire-instrument · deploy/bake-server-image.sh + internal/cli/cloud/support.go · stop the bake carrying the demo seed forward, and make the reset step report the count it deletes. Deferred by PDF-D103: landing it before P1 fires would silently degrade the reset step to a no-op and leave c65f517e2 untested. Hazards the brief names in full: the throwaway-key encryption window, schema_migrations must survive, KEEP_IMAGES=2 gives a two-night rollback runway, and set -euo pipefail means a non-zero reset kills the nightly bake silently. Gate: bash -n deploy/bake-server-image.sh && CC=clang go build ./... && go test ./internal/cli/cloud/....

Every gate above was dry-run at Decide before it was written into a task. The Go gate takes ~76s; the provisioner gate ~18s; both --plan modes exit 0 and leave no temp dir. Note tooling/fleet/fleet-run-verdict-test.sh does not exist yet — writing it IS part of slice 2, because there is no test harness for that file today.

Ledger hygiene done at Decide

task-d28779a3eeb39caf CLOSED on evidence (already fixed on origin/main — close, don't build). pdf-wc-support-proof CANCELLED as a zombie: it declared itself folded on 2026-07-24 while its superseding task finished, yet sat open at 0/8 with a claim expired 2026-07-24T01:15Z — its two still-live obligations (criteria 5 and 6) were absorbed VERBATIM into the epic as P2 and P3 before it was sealed, tightened to require a non-zero cost and extended to five census surfaces. pdf-bl-console-key-custody criterion 0 STAMPED from the D94 charter text, left open at 1/3 — closing it on a decision alone would be the lie; its remaining two criteria are Layer-2 construction this wave forbids. The three wound-tasks were re-parented under the epic and given criteria (they had none). The epic itself carried stale "considering — do not open" prose and zero criteria; it now carries 7, absorbing the zombie's two.

Backlog filed as published children — the ledger shows the future, not just the present: pdf-bl-anon-read-exposure (priority 0 — the live primary leaks its full ledger anonymously), pdf-bl-fleet-run-refresh (merged runner fixes never reach existing boxes), pdf-bl-orchestrator-spend-producer (the cap gate reads a file nothing writes), pdf-bl-cp-version-endpoint (deploy currency is an inference), pdf-bl-gui-workstation-spike (externals resolved; Computer-Use-not-on-Linux recorded), pdf-bl-fleet-ssh-key-singleton-tripwire (a second ssh-key would break every provision).

What this wave will NOT claim, stated before it runs. P3's removal of muscle-1 closes ONE of two exposure doors; the live primary's stays open until pdf-bl-anon-read-exposure is answered. Orders/day will be owner-DECLARED, not measured. The image seed's size is unmeasured until the reset step reports it. And a red P1 is a first-class finding, pre-authorised — including the PDS-D9 fail-closed refuse, which would be a LAWFUL red rather than evidence the fix failed.

REVIEW debrief (2026-07-28) — round 1 closed, grade A−

What shipped. Four slices, every gate re-run green in the review worktree, all branches pushed with PRs. (1) pdf-w1-p1-refire-instrument — final branch loop-epic/the-money-safe-live-fire-instrument-one--0-r: the money-safe P1 birth + P3 death instrument (R0 ABORT-only gates incl. the credential-empty law and the money-safety intersection gate; RED as a first-class classified finding with the PDS-D9 lawful-red arm; the D102 read from the CP row; PDF-D68 teardown on EITHER credential path; the PDF-D101 five-surface census with DNS swept BY VALUE), plus both journey-proof teardown holes closed. Review closed the builder's two named blind spots with FREE live smokes: hcloud zone rrset list -o json is a BARE ARRAY with records:[{value}] — the leg-5 parser's exact middle case, proven end-to-end against the live zone (known IP → guerrilla hit); and the loose census-time DNS-context grep became one anchored dns_ctx_listed() shared with rung 0i, proven to match main and reject a prefix.

(2) pdf-w1-honest-evidence — final branch loop-epic/headless-orders-stamp-evidence-they-actu-1-r: the PDS-D287 fix. The verdict predicate (HIGH-FLIP-RISK) was independently re-derived: every route to PASS requires either a parsed receipt with is_error literally false or a fresh post-claim artifact stat; every ambiguous state (no receipt, unparseable, stamp-noop, criterion-less TRAP C) lands MISS→release, never a close. 32/32 fixture gate. One review fix: the usage header's {{PROMPT}} custom-adapter example documented a substitution that never existed — the contract is the $FLEET_PROMPT env var, now stated and proven to expand at eval time.

(3) pdf-w1-dns-census-leg — branch loop-epic/bp-cloud-support-remove-deletes-the-a-re-2 UNCHANGED by review. The HIGH-FLIP-RISK label-vs-value judgment re-derived independently: only the ZONE derives from the CP row's URL (first-label strip); the record match is purely by VALUE on both sweep and census; and every degradation — wrong zone, the fleet token's zero-zone view, a failed delete — lands as census residue (could not verify dns), never a silent clean. Gate green, gofmt clean, 6 new tests incl. both-same-IP-records-gone-bystander-survives asserted against the fake zone itself. (4) pdf-w1-tokenid-loud-seam — branch loop-epic/an-empty-minted-token-id-stops-being-sil-3 UNCHANGED by review. Plumbing audit re-verified: exactly three r.tokenID sites, guarded assignment, custody fields unset on the fatal path, the token value in no narration; the operator-usable orphan-naming error text is pinned by six-phrase + RFC3339 asserts.

Ledger audit. One omission repaired: the dns-census slice's criterion 2 (the fifth census leg) was implemented and tested but its stamp never landed — review-stamped with evidence at the standing claim epoch, verified met by re-GET. All four slice tasks honestly in_progress with only merge-gated criteria open; pdf-w1-bake-seed-reset open/unclaimed as designed. The tokenid builder's un-fileable follow-on (pdf-w1-tokenid-orphan-reconcile: reconcile already-orphaned support tokens on the parent main + tighten supportParseMint's nested bare-id leniency, which could store a WRONG token id) was filed by review — the main's /v1/data/mutate was flapping 500s/timeouts during both the build and the review, so the filing ran on a retry loop; if it still shows GAVE-UP in the review transcript, the lead files it by hand from the description on this Paper.

What stalled, honestly. Nothing in-round. But the wave's headline deliverables — the GREEN refire (wish 1), the real Claude turn with spend evidence (wish 2), muscle-1's settlement, and P3's teardown of it — are all EXECUTIONS the review deliberately did not run: they cost real money and touch the live CP, and the wave plan assigns them to the lead/owner. This round delivered the instrument, the honest verdicts, and the two wound-fixes that make those executions mean something. Wish item 7 (BARKPARK_CLOUD_EGRESS_IPS on the CP host) is an ops rider nobody has run yet — it needs the CP host session the lead opens for the fire.

Grade A−, earned. Genuinely strong: four fence-disjoint slices, all green first try; the refire instrument is the best-constructed proof script this epic has produced (plan-mode side-effect-free by construction, money-before-verdicts sealing, classified RED, honest census skips); the verdict ladder inverts fleet-run.sh's dishonesty in exactly the mandated fail-closed direction with a self-contained 32-assert gate; both HIGH-FLIP-RISK judgments survived independent re-derivation. Short of A: the wave's proof-of-proofs is still unfired — by design, but the wish's own success metric (a green refire, a spend row) remains open until the lead executes; one ledger stamp had to be repaired in review; and the honest-evidence receipt fixtures are reconstructions, not byte-captured logs (safe direction, but a CLI rename would dodge them).

Next wave / lead runbook. (1) Merge in this order — tokenid-loud-seam, dns-census-leg, then the refire -r and honest-evidence -r (files disjoint; the seam and sweep must be in the tree before the fire so P1 tests the fixed chain); close each merge-gated criterion on merge. (2) FIRE scripts/pdf-p1-refire.sh from a shell with HCLOUD_TOKEN unset (both hcloud contexts carry the credentials); commit the token-scanned transcript; stamp the epic's refire criterion from it. A lawful red (workspace_slug_conflict) confirms the seed wound and green-lights round 2. (3) Dispatch pdf-w1-bake-seed-reset ONLY after P1's color is recorded (PDF-D103). (4) P2 (the real Claude turn on a box) and the ops rider ride the same CP session. (5) E2 flip-risk: a genuinely independent second reviewer before merge is warranted on the honest-evidence verdict predicate and the refire teardown-credential judgment. (6) muscle-1: still up, still anonymously serving 3,866 docs — P3 it with the merged remover, and pdf-bl-anon-read-exposure stays the top-priority owner ruling this wave did not touch.

Claude-Ready Servers — Wave 1: Proof Before Build

Living wave paper. Opened at Strategize 2026-07-28. Every later phase appends here: Digest adds the survey digest + verify plan, Decide adds decisions + the wave plan, Review closes the story as the debrief. Epic task: task-claude-ready-servers-epic-candidate. Charter: .claude/workflows/bp-personal-dev-fleet-charter.md (PDF-D94..D96 ratified at a1583aed5). Research inherited: claude-ready-servers-capstone · claude-ready-servers-honest-review · claude-ready-servers-pipeline-recipe · claude-ready-servers-barkpark-utilization.

Where the wave stands

COMPLETE: REVIEWED, grade A−. [Correction, Review 2026-07-28: this block still read “IN FLIGHT: VERIFYING” after Decide appended its sections — the Decide phase never updated it.] All 4 round-1 slices built green, adversarially re-reviewed, two review fixes committed on -r branches, ledger repaired (one un-landed stamp), branches pushed with PRs. The live fires (P1/P2/P3) are LEAD/OWNER executions and have NOT run yet; round-2 pdf-w1-bake-seed-reset stays deferred until the instrument merges AND P1 fires (PDF-D103). Debrief below.

The wish (owner ruling 2026-07-28: pursue now)

Make the system stop lying before anything is built. Seven deliverables: (1) a GREEN provision_support re-fire post-c65f517e2 — none exists on the ledger; (2) PROOF a fleet box executes a real Claude turn — a spend.jsonl row or equivalent hard evidence, including settling muscle-1's real state; (3) the honest-evidence fix — tooling/fleet/fleet-run.sh stamps canned --met and closes unconditionally, violating PDS-D287; (4) the three wound-tasks (task-a0304711e4fe683c bake seed-lineage, task-688ebffc4b0aa50a A-record leak on remove, task-b9c0f988cd0019d4 fleet_token_id nil); (5) first spend telemetry — measured orders/day + token-spend; (6) OPTIONAL+SEVERABLE 1-day GUI spike on a throwaway cx33; (7) ops rider: set BARKPARK_CLOUD_EGRESS_IPS in /etc/barkpark-provisioner.env on the CP host. Hard constraints: nothing sellable; no Layer 1/2/3 construction beyond what proof and the wound-fixes require; PDF-D94..D96 are law — no step may write a provider key that is KEPT; verify work follows the D96 split.

Direction — the biography of one support box

The wave is organized around a single instrumented support-box lifecycle on the real control plane, bracketed by the cheapest truth first and the fixes proven live. The finished experience: one transcript-backed story — probe, birth, work, death — after which every sentence the fleet says about itself is either proven or honestly absent.

P0 — Probe (seconds, before anything else). A CP-credentialed SSH probe of muscle-1 (capstone ruling O7): does spend.jsonl hold real rows, does the claude binary exist, does fleet-listener.env hold a credential? This can settle deliverable 2 instantly — or prove the zero. Either answer is a deliverable. While hands are on the CP host, execute the egress-IPs ops rider in the same session.

P1 — Birth (the re-fire, on the AS-IS chain). One green provision_support end-to-end, sealed with a job id, fired BEFORE the wound-fixes land — that is the only way to learn whether c65f517e2 alone repaired the chain. A red re-fire is not a wave failure: it is a first-class finding that re-scopes the wave to diagnose-and-fix (the honest-review pre-authorizes exactly this branch).

P2 — Work (the turn). Dispatch one real order to the box; a real claude -p turn produces a real total_cost_usd row in spend.jsonl. Key delivery stays on rung 0 (the printed SSH one-liner, delivered for the turn, never kept) — no rung-1 construction this wave. If the honest-evidence fix (F1) has merged by then, the same turn also demonstrates PDS-D287-honest stamping live: one order, two proofs.

P3 — Death (the remove census). After the wound-fixes merge and the CP redeploys, remove the box with the four-surface verify-gone census (PDF-D63) — which is exactly the live proof of the A-record fix and the fleet_token_id/token-revoke fix. The box's death certifies the repairs its birth exposed.

F — Fixes (parallel, file-disjoint, small). F1 honest-evidence in fleet-run.sh (evidence is a post-condition read or agent-authored from the JSON receipt — real or absent, never canned); F2 the three wound-tasks; F3 close task-d28779a3eeb39caf on evidence (deploy.yml already carries internal/** + cmd/** on origin/main — close, don't build). Sequencing rule: the bake seed-lineage fix must NOT land before P1's baseline re-fire (it changes the chain under test).

T — Telemetry (falls out, no machinery). First measured orders/day + token-spend = muscle-1's historical rows (if any) + P2's row(s), aggregated by the leanest possible reader (a script or a paper section, not a new surface — the simplicity law). Economics graduate from models to at least one measurement.

S — Spike (severable side-quest). The 1-day GUI spike (KasmVNC + claude-desktop on a throwaway cx33) runs whenever a day is free, in whatever hcloud project is disposable; if it fails, Layer 4 dies without grief and nothing else moves.

Direction debate — rivals weighed

Rival A — parallel checklist. Treat the seven deliverables as seven independent slices and fan out. Fast, maximally parallel — but it wastes the compounding structure: the wound-fix proofs WANT the live box the re-fire creates; the re-fire baseline WANTS to run before the bake fix mutates the chain; the honest-evidence fix landing before the turn makes one order prove two things. Parallel-blind sequencing risks proving against divergent states and paying for extra boxes.

Rival B — fix-first, then prove. Land all fixes, then one live fire proves the repaired chain. Rejected: it destroys the baseline (we would never learn whether c65f517e2 sufficed), and it builds on an unproven chain — the exact sin this wave exists to stop.

Winner — the box biography (A's parallelism inside B's inverse). Fix slices run in parallel from minute one (they are file-disjoint builds), but the PROOF spine is strictly ordered probe → birth → work → death, with the two coupling rules made explicit (bake fix after baseline; remove census after fixes deploy). The lifecycle is the spine, not the only lane.

Sharpest attack on the winner: the spine is serial, so a red re-fire could stall the wave behind one failure. Absorbed three ways: the probe (P0) runs first and is independent; the fix lanes never wait on the spine; and the red-re-fire branch is pre-authorized as a re-scope to diagnose-and-fix — the wave's title is Proof Before Build, and a proven failure IS proof. Second attack: this Mac may hold no CP-project credential (two-project split), making P0/P1 unreachable from here — survey lane cp-access-paths exists precisely to settle who can hold the wrench before Decide assigns hands.

Premise smoke — run at Strategize

Citations fired, not trusted: a1583aed5 exists on origin/main and adds exactly PDF-D94..D96 to the PDF charter; their text covers what the wish cites (D94 never-writes→never-keeps rung-1 custody; D95 four tiers; D96 verify split). PDS-D287 exists (bp-pds-charter.md:4145) and says what the wish claims. c65f517e2 exists (fleet: reset image-seeded default workspace + re-mint box admin token). Code sites re-read on origin/main: fleet-run.sh:237-239 IS the canned --met stamp + unconditional close, both silenced with >/dev/null 2>&1 — the violation is real and worse than described (stamp AND close failures are invisible). supportAgentInstallStep (support.go) is still the fail-open npm step. provision_support claim route is real and kind-filtered (registry.ex:1245), with per-kind 35-min staleness landed. All three wound-tasks are open on the ledger and their described defects match origin/main code.

Two findings from smoke: (1) The wish cites 9110a0ebe for BARKPARK_CLOUD_EGRESS_IPS — that commit is an honest-gates charter commit; the real carrier is ea3849a5e (#6241, mobile-charter task-e8e4cbdf15098c98). The rider itself is sound: the env var is read at cmd/barkpark-provisioner/main.go:232 and unset means per-caller rate buckets collapse. (2) task-d28779a3eeb39caf (deploy.yml cp filter misses provisioner source) is still OPEN but the fix is verifiably on origin/main (paths + filter both carry internal/** and cmd/**) — close on evidence, don't build. Also verified live: this Mac's hcloud has BOTH contexts (main = guerrilla active, barkpark = fleet/CP) — whether the barkpark context token is valid is a survey question, since memory says the fleet credential lives only on barkpark-cp.

Survey plan — 16 lanes

Each lane is one Opus surveyor. Width now buys precise depth later; the Digest phase distills.

cp-access-paths. What access does this Mac/repo actually have to the CP host (178.105.92.191) and to fleet boxes? SSH keys/config, validity of the local hcloud 'barkpark' context, deploy-key custody, GitHub Actions as remote hands. — WHY: Every proof deliverable routes through CP-credentialed hands; if no path exists from here, Decide must reshape who executes P0/P1.

muscle-1-state. Everything knowable about muscle-1 WITHOUT SSH: CP DB row, guerrilla roster row + beat contents, DNS/TLS liveness, hcloud census. Build the seconds-long SSH probe checklist for P0. — WHY: P0's checklist must be ready-to-run; and roster/DNS evidence bounds what the probe can find.

refire-trigger-path. The exact real path to fire a provision_support job from here: bp cloud support add flow, credentials needed, CP-side support_claim_map, and parent-main prerequisites. — WHY: Deliverable 1 is unreachable until the trigger path and its credentials are named.

deployed-sha-truth. What sha the deployed CP app and bp-provisioner binary are actually running, and how an agent verifies it (deploy.yml run history, version endpoints, CP logs). — WHY: A re-fire against a pre-c65f517e2 worker proves nothing; the deployed-sha check is P1's precondition R0.

refire-failure-history. Reconstruct the three live provisioning failures (c65f517e2 commit message, PR #6116 round-5, job 1fee2bb6): what failed, what each fix changed, what remains untested on the chain. — WHY: Defines P1's expected failure modes and what a red re-fire would most likely mean.

honest-evidence-design. Design space for the fleet-run.sh fix: structure of claude/codex JSON receipts, what generic post-condition reads are possible for arbitrary orders, how stamp/close errors should surface, PDS-D287-compliant precedents in the repo. — WHY: Deliverable 3's builder needs a ruled design, not an open question.

wound-bake-lineage. task-a0304711e4fe683c mechanics: where seed docs ride forward in bake-server-image.sh, what a reset touches, interaction with SupportResetDefaultWorkspaceStep, and what a wrong fix does to the nightly bake. — WHY: Highest blast radius of the three wounds — the image every box boots; also pins the sequencing rule (fix after baseline re-fire).

wound-a-record. task-688ebffc4b0aa50a diff sites: both remove surfaces' current code, warmpool cleanupHost semantics to mirror, reusability of the worker-side teardown DNS delete. — WHY: Turns the wound into a precise small diff instead of an exploration.

wound-token-id. task-b9c0f988cd0019d4 end-to-end trace on origin/main: contentMintToken → succeed call → CP succeed_job persistence; registry.ex:1511 cites task-5866ec745efcd7f7 — did a fix already land? Was the live nil a deployed-sha artifact? — WHY: Might be a close-don't-build; otherwise the trace names the broken half.

spend-telemetry-shape. What exists for reading/aggregating spend.jsonl (record_spend, dispatch cap gate); the leanest 'first measured orders/day + token-spend signal' satisfying deliverable 5 with zero new machinery; where rows could exist today. — WHY: Keeps deliverable 5 from bloating into Layer construction.

key-delivery-rung0. The lawful (D94) key path for one real turn: the printed one-liner in cloud_support_cmd.go, what env var the claude adapter needs on the box, deliver-then-remove mechanics so nothing is KEPT, and whether muscle-1 already holds a credential. — WHY: Without a lawful key path deliverable 2 is impossible; with a kept key the wave breaks its own law.

gui-spike-recipe. The gui-workstation paper's spike design turned into an executable one-day order: KasmVNC install path (no apt package), claude-desktop apt source, kiosk unit, sign-in, reboot, RAM measurement, teardown, cost, and which hcloud project hosts the throwaway. — WHY: Makes deliverable 6 a dispatchable order with a kill-clean guarantee.

egress-rider. And a red P1 is a first-class finding, pre-authorised — including the PDS-D9 fail-closed refuse, which would be a LAWFUL red rather than evidence the fix failed.

REVIEW debrief (2026-07-28) — round 1 closed, grade A−

What shipped. Four slices, every gate re-run green in the review worktree, all branches pushed with PRs. (1) pdf-w1-p1-refire-instrument — final branch loop-epic/the-money-safe-live-fire-instrument-one--0-r: the money-safe P1 birth + P3 death instrument (R0 ABORT-only gates incl. the credential-empty law and the money-safety intersection gate; RED as a first-class classified finding with the PDS-D9 lawful-red arm; the D102 read from the CP row; PDF-D68 teardown on EITHER credential path; the PDF-D101 five-surface census with DNS swept BY VALUE), plus both journey-proof teardown holes closed. Review closed the builder's two named blind spots with FREE live smokes: hcloud zone rrset list -o json is a BARE ARRAY with records:[{value}] — the leg-5 parser's exact middle case, proven end-to-end against the live zone (known IP → guerrilla hit); and the loose census-time DNS-context grep became one anchored dns_ctx_listed() shared with rung 0i, proven to match main and reject a prefix.

(2) pdf-w1-honest-evidence — final branch loop-epic/headless-orders-stamp-evidence-they-actu-1-r: the PDS-D287 fix. The verdict predicate (HIGH-FLIP-RISK) was independently re-derived: every route to PASS requires either a parsed receipt with is_error literally false or a fresh post-claim artifact stat; every ambiguous state (no receipt, unparseable, stamp-noop, criterion-less TRAP C) lands MISS→release, never a close. 32/32 fixture gate. One review fix: the usage header's {{PROMPT}} custom-adapter example documented a substitution that never existed — the contract is the $FLEET_PROMPT env var, now stated and proven to expand at eval time.

(3) pdf-w1-dns-census-leg — branch loop-epic/bp-cloud-support-remove-deletes-the-a-re-2 UNCHANGED by review. The HIGH-FLIP-RISK label-vs-value judgment re-derived independently: only the ZONE derives from the CP row's URL (first-label strip); the record match is purely by VALUE on both sweep and census; and every degradation — wrong zone, the fleet token's zero-zone view, a failed delete — lands as census residue (could not verify dns), never a silent clean. Gate green, gofmt clean, 6 new tests incl. both-same-IP-records-gone-bystander-survives asserted against the fake zone itself. (4) pdf-w1-tokenid-loud-seam — branch loop-epic/an-empty-minted-token-id-stops-being-sil-3 UNCHANGED by review. Plumbing audit re-verified: exactly three r.tokenID sites, guarded assignment, custody fields unset on the fatal path, the token value in no narration; the operator-usable orphan-naming error text is pinned by six-phrase + RFC3339 asserts.

Ledger audit. One omission repaired: the dns-census slice's criterion 2 (the fifth census leg) was implemented and tested but its stamp never landed — review-stamped with evidence at the standing claim epoch, verified met by re-GET. All four slice tasks honestly in_progress with only merge-gated criteria open; pdf-w1-bake-seed-reset open/unclaimed as designed. The tokenid builder's un-fileable follow-on (pdf-w1-tokenid-orphan-reconcile: reconcile already-orphaned support tokens on the parent main + tighten supportParseMint's nested bare-id leniency, which could store a WRONG token id) was filed by review — the main's /v1/data/mutate was flapping 500s/timeouts during both the build and the review, so the filing ran on a retry loop; if it still shows GAVE-UP in the review transcript, the lead files it by hand from the description on this Paper.

What stalled, honestly. Nothing in-round. But the wave's headline deliverables — the GREEN refire (wish 1), the real Claude turn with spend evidence (wish 2), muscle-1's settlement, and P3's teardown of it — are all EXECUTIONS the review deliberately did not run: they cost real money and touch the live CP, and the wave plan assigns them to the lead/owner. This round delivered the instrument, the honest verdicts, and the two wound-fixes that make those executions mean something. Wish item 7 (BARKPARK_CLOUD_EGRESS_IPS on the CP host) is an ops rider nobody has run yet — it needs the CP host session the lead opens for the fire.

Grade A−, earned. Genuinely strong: four fence-disjoint slices, all green first try; the refire instrument is the best-constructed proof script this epic has produced (plan-mode side-effect-free by construction, money-before-verdicts sealing, classified RED, honest census skips); the verdict ladder inverts fleet-run.sh's dishonesty in exactly the mandated fail-closed direction with a self-contained 32-assert gate; both HIGH-FLIP-RISK judgments survived independent re-derivation. Short of A: the wave's proof-of-proofs is still unfired — by design, but the wish's own success metric (a green refire, a spend row) remains open until the lead executes; one ledger stamp had to be repaired in review; and the honest-evidence receipt fixtures are reconstructions, not byte-captured logs (safe direction, but a CLI rename would dodge them).

Next wave / lead runbook. (1) Merge in this order — tokenid-loud-seam, dns-census-leg, then the refire -r and honest-evidence -r (files disjoint; the seam and sweep must be in the tree before the fire so P1 tests the fixed chain); close each merge-gated criterion on merge. (2) FIRE scripts/pdf-p1-refire.sh from a shell with HCLOUD_TOKEN unset (both hcloud contexts carry the credentials); commit the token-scanned transcript; stamp the epic's refire criterion from it. A lawful red (workspace_slug_conflict) confirms the seed wound and green-lights round 2. (3) Dispatch pdf-w1-bake-seed-reset ONLY after P1's color is recorded (PDF-D103). (4) P2 (the real Claude turn on a box) and the ops rider ride the same CP session. (5) E2 flip-risk: a genuinely independent second reviewer before merge is warranted on the honest-evidence verdict predicate and the refire teardown-credential judgment. (6) muscle-1: still up, still anonymously serving 3,866 docs — P3 it with the merged remover, and pdf-bl-anon-read-exposure stays the top-priority owner ruling this wave did not touch.
